mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5%, the S&P 500 exhibits positive 20-day forward returns due to accommodative monetary policy reducing discount rates for equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% within the past month triggers negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns as it signals deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPIAUCSL and decrease in FEDFUNDS predicts negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days due to rising real interest rates and reduced corporate profit margins during monetary policy tightening.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising CPIAUCSL and falling FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), a rising CPIAUCSL predicts negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days as central banks tighten policy to combat inflation, reducing equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 700.0 thousand units predicts negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as it signals weakening consumer demand and economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST falls below 700.0.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 predicts negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as it indicates weakening manufacturing activity and reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 within the past month triggers negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to reduced economic output and corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO falls below 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.5%), a rising UNRATE predicts negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days as it reflects immediate economic weakness and reduced consumer spending power.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%.
